title: Investor's Last Exam: Can AI Agents Do Equity Investment Without Seeing the Future?
abstract: arXiv:2610.38342v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial agents must form forecasts and investment judgments from decision-time evidence, with predictions evaluated against subsequent outcomes. Existing benchmarks assess financial knowledge, research workflows, or forecasting, but evaluating the full research process requires a strictly frozen information set and professional evaluation criteria. We introduce Investor's Last Exam (ILE), an equity-research benchmark led by experienced buy-side investors and fund managers. Its three components are a versioned financial database spanning 3.43 million document versions and nine source categories, supplemented by structured market data, with validated timestamps governing retrieval and computation; a task taxonomy organized around professional analyst deliverables; and an expert-led framework linking scoring criteria to sources, calculations, and assumptions through financial dependency graphs. translated_title: 投资者的终极考试：AI智能体能否在不预知未来的情况下进行股票投资？
translated_abstract: 金融智能体必须基于决策时点的证据形成预测和投资判断，其预测将根据后续实际结果进行评估。现有基准测试主要评估金融知识、研究工作流程或预测能力，但要对完整的研究过程进行评估，需要严格冻结的信息集和专业的评估标准。我们提出了“投资者终极考试”（Investor's Last Exam，简称ILE），这是一个由经验丰富的买方投资者和基金经理主导的股票研究基准测试。该基准包含三个组成部分：一是版本化的金融数据库，涵盖343万个文档版本和九类数据来源，辅以结构化市场数据，并通过经验证的时间戳来管控信息检索与计算；二是围绕专业分析师交付成果组织的任务分类体系；三是由专家主导的评估框架，通过金融依赖关系图将评分标准与数据来源、计算过程和假设条件相联系。评估涵盖86项任务，并联合……
tldr: 该论文提出了由资深买方投资者主导的股票研究基准“投资者终极考试”（ILE），通过严格冻结的信息集、343万版本化文档的金融数据库以及基于金融依赖关系图的专家评估框架，首次实现了对AI金融智能体完整研究过程的专业化评估。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Investor's Last Exam (ILE), an equity-research benchmark led by experienced buy-side investors that enables professional evaluation of AI financial agents' complete research process through a strictly frozen information set, a versioned financial database spanning 3.43 million document versions, and an expert-led scoring framework linked via financial dependency graphs.
